about: Hello's link identity per musl runtime, keyed by the SHA-256 of the libwolf_rt.a the link used: the archive members LLD 17.0.6 extracts (by archive, counted) and its globally or weakly defined symbol names. tests/static-pax.py holds ligature's hello to the entry for the runtime it linked and refuses by name when no entry exists. A new pin adds an entry from the oracle's own trace and nm, never from ligature's output.

entries.source: LLD 17.0.6 --trace and nm -g --defined-only of its hello, linked on x86-64 Linux at the 0.2.38 pin on 2026-11-09 (the take recorded in notes/ld03b/classification-red-hello-identity-be8bd052.log); the six libc members new since 0.2.35 are getpriority, mkdirat, rewinddir, setpriority, statvfs and symlinkat, demanded by the 0.2.38 runtime
